data.long_description:
Provident presents this spacious and well-designed 2-bedroom apartment in 1 Residences Tower 1, located in the highly sought-after Wasl1 community beside Zabeel Park.

Unit Features:

⦁ 2 Bedrooms
⦁ 3 Bathrooms
⦁ Ready to Move In
⦁ Unfurnished
⦁ Spacious Balcony
⦁ Built-in Wardrobes
⦁ Covered Parking

Amenities:

⦁ 24/7 Security
⦁ Shared Gymnasium
⦁ Shared Swimming Pool
⦁ Reception & Lobby Area

This stunning luxury apartment offers a spacious and thoughtfully designed living area, ideal for modern urban living. Residents enjoy close proximity to some of Dubai’s finest restaurants, retail destinations, and iconic attractions.

Perfectly positioned alongside the lush greenery of Zabeel Park, 1 Residences offers a unique blend of tranquility and city convenience. Residents can wake up to refreshing park views, enjoy peaceful walks, and experience a vibrant lifestyle only minutes away from Dubai’s major landmarks.

Nearby Destinations:

⦁ Approximately 8 Minutes to Dubai Mall
⦁ Approximately 19 Minutes to Palm Jumeirah
⦁ Approximately 18 Minutes to Burj Al Arab
⦁ Approximately 23 Minutes to The Walk at JBR
